title: The time filter in Google Search broke a few days ago
summary: A bug report describing how Google's time filter feature in search stopped working for several days, preventing users from filtering search results by time period.
problem_solved: Reports a bug where the time filter in Google Search stopped functioning properly for days.
why_valuable: This serves as a user bug report documenting a real issue with a widely-used search feature, though it doesn't provide technical solutions.
